description: Single source of truth for the Kodi bridge command surface. Used by the addon for dispatch validation, by the skill for documentation, and by the bridge for parameter checks.

play.summary: Start playback of a URL or local file.

file.description: Stream URL, local file, or smb:// path.

item_id.description: Flixify item ID — enables quality fallback + watch-ledger tracking.

quality.description: Quality tier the URL represents. Required for fallback to function.

resume_position_seconds.description: Seek to this position after playback starts. Used by the watchdog to restore position on quality downgrades.

stop.summary: Stop playback and clear the current item.

mute.summary: Mute or unmute the application audio.

mute.description: true to mute, false to unmute. Accepts the alias 'muted' for backwards compatibility.

notify.summary: Show a toast notification on the Kodi UI.

input.summary: Send a remote-control input action to the UI.

activate_window.summary: Navigate to a Kodi top-level window.

activate_addon.summary: Launch a specific Kodi addon by its addon id.

browse.summary: List the contents of a Kodi directory (smb://, file://, or plugin://). Caches the result for select_item.

path.description: Directory path. plugin:// URLs are supported despite older docs to the contrary.

select_item.summary: Select an item from the most recent browse() result by 0-based index or by exact file_path.

index.description: 0-based position in the last browse result.

file_path.description: Exact file path string from the browse result.

select_item.notes: Must supply exactly one of index or file_path.

seek.summary: Seek to an absolute position in the current playback.
seek.notes: Provide either time or seconds, not both.

step.summary: Jump forward or backward by a number of seconds.

flixify_search.summary: Open Flixify search results in the addon UI.
flixify_search.notes: Opens UI only. For Alfred-driven playback, use the Python flixify client + `play` with a direct stream URL.

flixify_play.summary: Play a Flixify item by ID via the Kodi plugin (legacy, unreliable).
flixify_play.notes: DEPRECATED. Routes through the Flixify Kodi plugin which is unreliable. Prefer fetching the URL via Python flixify.get_best_url() and queuing `play` directly.
